summary: Ero Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing the timing of its third quarter 2026 operating and financial results, scheduled for release on November 2, 2026, after market close, with a conference call on November 3, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-timing notice for a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, not a special situation. Watch for actual Q3 operational and financial disclosures.
